philippines.title: ‘Ex-NPA’ logistics officer nabbed in Bukidnon military intel compound
philippines.description:
CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — An alleged former logistics officer of the Maoist New People’s Army (NPA) wanted for murder was arrested inside a military intelligence compound in Malaybalay City, Bukidnon on Wednesday afternoon, July 22. In a press statement, the Police Regional Office-10 (PRO-10) identified the suspect as Gemma Pensahan Tilucan, 32, who is wanted for murder and frustrated murder. Tilucan, who is known by aliases Gina, Tata, Alex, Reps, and Jea, was apprehended inside the 43rd Military Intelligence Company compound in Barangay 10, Malaybalay City at 2:40 p.m., it said. philippines.title: Governor's Cup to return with a bang
philippines.description:
CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu’s biggest provincial basketball tournament is making a long-awaited comeback. After a seven-year hiatus, the Governor’s Cup U18 Basketball Tournament was officially relaunched on Thursday, July 23, as the Cebu Provincial Government unveiled its plans for the 2026 edition, which tips off on Sept. 26. The launch at the Cebu Provincial Capitol was led by Governor Pamela Baricuatro, Cebu Provincial Sports Commission (CPSC) Chairman Dr. Rhoel Dejano, commissioners Mark Anthony Ynoc and consultant Dr. Janos Vizcayno, and CPSC Executive Director Engr. philippines.description:
CEBU CITY, Philippines — Cebu Province could soon have its own world-class sports complex, with Governor Pamela Baricuatro revealing plans to build a premier facility in northern Cebu as part of her administration’s push to transform the province into a major sports tourism destination.
